items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: They got a good bass player. What is her name? She's a lady bass player? Is her name Davis, Louise Davis.

ctx.x: Yeah, well I just have one. I just take the piano player.
Oh I see. I thought you took your bass player too.
No. They got a good bass player. What is her name? She's a lady bass player? Is her name Davis, Louise Davis.
